result.stderr:
USAGE:
    semver.dll [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    semver.dll 
    semver.dll --prefix api- -f apps/api
    semver.dll -p alpha -b

OPTIONS:
                             DEFAULT                                            
    -h, --help                          Prints help information                 
        --prefix <PREFIX>               Literal tag prefix for monorepo         
                                        scenarios                               
    -f, --folder <PATH>                 Repository-relative folder whose commits
                                        determine the version                   
    -p, --prerelease <ID>               Prerelease label; the matching commit   
                                        count is appended automatically         
    -b, --buildmetadata                 Include the effective HEAD short SHA as 
                                        build metadata                          
    -o, --output <FORMAT>    Text       Output format: text or json
